items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: After my band broke up, you know, the blind Freddie got me with him, you know, with Amos Riley.

ctx.x: After my band broke up, you know, the blind Freddie got me with him, you know, with Amos Riley. Then I had Amos Riley with us on the car in the Arlene Creole Jazz Band. Had him with us in there.
